title: 'tab to amend' hint on permission prompts does nothing; tab is silently swallowed
observed: Bash approval prompt's hint row reads '↑↓ select · enter confirm · esc decline · tab to amend'. Pressing Tab (before-tab -> after-tab) leaves the prompt pixel-identical (still on 'Allow kiln to run this command?' with option 1 selected, no feedback field appears). Typing 'please explain what this does first' afterward does not populate any amend/feedback field — after-typing shows the bottom input line reading 'se explain what this does first' (leading characters swallowed) while the approval prompt is gone, and pressing enter runs the command as approved: after-enter shows 'bash ... approved · 2.8s' / 'Ran the probe command.', not a decline with the typed reason.
expected: Tab should open a feedback/amend field on the prompt (or otherwise honor the advertised affordance) and Enter should submit a decline carrying the typed reason (expected screen text '✕ Declined echo tab-amend-probe'), per the scenario's own EXPECT at bash-deny-feedback-tab.steps:36.
design_ref: internal/tui/permission_render.go:197,334 (hint text 'tab to amend'); internal/tui/permissionview.go promptOptionsFor("bash") has no feedback option; PromptState.HandleKey has no tab case and falls through the digit-key default branch for any other key
